messages.subject: rApache + ChrootDir
parts:
Since version 2.2, Apache2 mpm-prefork, and mpm-worker have a ChrootDir directive. See http://httpd.apache.org/docs/2.2/mod/mpm_common.html. I tried enabling it but nothing seemed to happen. 

Has anyone here tried / succeeded chrooting rApache?
